verses.t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
verses.yusufAli: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
verses.rodwell: SAY: I betake me for refuge to the Lord of the DAY BREAK
verses.sale: Say, I fly for refuge unto the Lord of the day-break

verses.t: From the evil of that which He created
verses.pickthall: From the evil of that which He created
verses.yusufAli: From the mischief of created things
verses.rodwell: Against the mischiefs of his creation
verses.sale: that He may deliver me from the mischief of those things which He hath created

verses.t: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense
verses.yusufAli: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads
verses.rodwell: And against the mischief of the night when it overtaketh me
verses.sale: and from the mischief of the night, when it cometh on

verses.t: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft
verses.yusufAli: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts
verses.rodwell: And against the mischief of weird women
verses.sale: and from the mischief of women blowing on knots

verses.t: And from the evil of an envier when he envies
verses.pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth
verses.yusufAli: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy
verses.rodwell: And against the mischief of the envier when he envieth
verses.sale: and from the mischief of the envious, when he envieth
